instruction: Look at freecad_task-6_input.step in FreeCAD. Use the Part Design workbench throughout; activate the Body, create new sketches on the required faces or planes, and complete all fused features in the same Body using GUI additive and subtractive features. Build a dense heat-sink and mounting feature set on the base while keeping the 130 x 80 x 8 mm base plate. Add a raised thermal pad 70 x 44 x 4 mm centered on the base top face. Add twelve parallel fins fused to the base, each 110 mm long along X, 3 mm thick along Y, and 30 mm high, with fin bottom at Z=8 mm; the first fin centerline is Y=11.5 mm and the pitch is 5.5 mm. Cut four vertical mounting holes of diameter 6.4 mm at (15,15), (115,15), (15,65), and (115,65), with a top counterbore diameter 14 mm and depth 4 mm. Also cut two vertical obround cable slots centered at (42,40) and (88,40), each total length 28 mm along Y and width 8 mm. Export /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-6_output.step using only the GUI; no script files may be used.
